newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling creeps vs dollar on export inflows.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling creeps vs dollar on export inflows.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling continued its steady creep against the dollar on Thursday boosted by inflows from agricultural exports, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 53.43 against the dollar from 53.44 on Wednesday, while against the pound, the shilling was posted at a commercial mean of 87.23 from 87.39.

Dealers said the shilling would continue posting gains against the dollar during the day : "It's moving very slowly but a lot of people were caught in long (dollar) positions yesterday (Wednesday) from the export sales," one dealer said.
The money market continued liquid. Overnight rates were quoted at 7-8 percent levels from 10 percent on Wednesday.
